findings.description: Physical gesture freezes call identity and intended Cancel/End verb; stale release cannot upgrade the action.
Cancelled and outside gestures retire; first fresh assistive activation remains available.
Release while disabled without a click retires intent; call reset cancels held keyboard release defaults without blocking a later fresh action.
